text:
Great question! Here's what happens when you delete your account:

**Account deletion:**
- You can delete your account under "Account" > "Privacy"
- The deletion process takes up to **30 days**
- **Your Plant Club subscription will be automatically cancelled** as part of the deletion

**Important timing note:**
Since Plant Club is charged on the **25th** of the previous month, if you delete your account before the 25th this month (October 25th), the next box won't be charged. However, if you've already been charged for a box that hasn't shipped yet, that box will still be sent to you—we don't refund already-billed boxes when cancelling.

**If you want to cancel Plant Club first** (without deleting your account), you can do that separately anytime from "Account" > "Subscriptions" with no cancellation fee.

Is there anything else I can help clarify about your account or subscription?
